title: 【已复现】GitLab 正则表达式编译器未授权远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2026-97229)安全风险通告

table_fields.漏洞名称: GitLab 正则表达式编译器未授权远程代码执行漏洞

sections.intro_text: 安全团队 2026-10-14 16:06 ● **漏洞详情** **>** **>** **>** **>** **影响组件** GitLab 是由 GitLab Inc. 开发的一体化 DevOps 平台，提供代码托管、CI/CD、包与容器镜像管理等能力，广泛部署于企业内网与公网自托管环境。其内嵌 Ruby 运行时（Onigmo 正则引擎）负责解析和编译 `.gitlab-ci.yml` 中的各类正则表达式。 **>** **>** **>** **>** **漏洞描述** 近日，安全团队监测到官方修复 GitLab 正则表达式编译器未授权远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2026-97229)，该漏洞源于 GitLab 内嵌 Ruby（Onigmo 正则引擎）在编译 CI/CD 配置中的正则表达式时存在整数溢出与内存管理缺陷：特制的正则表达式可在编译阶段造成内存破坏。攻击者可借由 CI/CD 配置处理链路（包括无需认证即可到达的接口）在 GitLab 服务端进程（Puma/Sidekiq）中执行任意代码。 目前该漏洞PoC和技术细节已公开。 鉴于该漏洞影响范围较大，建议客户尽快做好自查及防护。 **>** **>** **>** **>** **利用条件** 攻击者能够向实例上的公开项目推送分支并提交 CI 配置文件（含特制的正则表达式与文件路径）。 **影响范围** **>** **>** **>** **>** **影响版本** GitLab CE/EE 19.2 ** **>** **>** **>** **安全更新** 官方已发布安全补丁，请及时更新至最新版本： GitLab CE/EE ≥ 19.2.8 GitLab CE/EE ≥ 19.3.5 GitLab CE/EE ≥ 19.4.2（或更高受支持版本） 下载地址： https://about.gitlab.com/update/ 临时缓解措施： 1. 收缩暴露面：限制 GitLab 实例的互联网直接访问（VPN/白名单）； 2. 关闭或收紧用户注册与项目创建权限，降低攻击者预置条件； 3. 审计并轮换全部 pipeline trigger token，停用不再使用的触发器； 4. 加强监控：关注 Puma/Sidekiq 异常重启、[BUG] Segmentation fault 日志与容器 oom_kill 计数。

This is fixed in 19.3.5. These versions contain important bug and security fixes, and we strongly recommend that all self-managed GitLab installations be upgraded to one of these versions immediately. GitLab.com is already running the patched version. GitLab Dedicated customers do not need to take action. GitLab releases fixes for vulnerabilities in patch releases. There are two types of patch releases: scheduled releases and ad-hoc critical patches for high-severity vulnerabilities. Scheduled releases are released twice a month on the second and fourth Wednesdays. For more information, please visit our releases handbook and security FAQ . You can see all of GitLab release blog posts here . For security fixes, the issues detailing each vulnerability are made public on our issue tracker 90 days after the release in which they were patched. We are committed to ensuring that all aspects of GitLab that are exposed to customers or that host customer data are held to the highest security standards. To maintain good security hygiene, it is highly recommended that all customers upgrade to the latest patch release for their supported version. You can read more best practices in securing your GitLab instance in our blog post. Recommended Action We strongly recommend that all installations running a version affected by the issues described below are upgraded to the latest version as soon as possible . When no specific deployment type (omnibus, source code, helm chart, etc.) of a product is mentioned, it means all types are affected. An attacker with permission to push to a public project supplies a CI regular expression and a specially named path. After that setup, a request without credentials executes the selected command as the GitLab git account. This is an initial PoC release. Analysis of the vulnerability, affected configurations, and additional reachable paths is ongoing. A full technical write-up will follow. GitLab rates the issue CVSS 10.0. It affects GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition from 19.2 before 19.2.8 , 19.3 before 19.3.5 , and 19.4 before 19.4.2 . An ordinary project account is sufficient for this setup step. Users without an account can read that project and reach GET /api/v4/projects/:id/ci/lint for the delivery step

payload.vulner_desc: GitLab 在处理 CI/CD 配置时存在整数溢出漏洞，根源在于其内嵌 Ruby 环境中的 Onigmo 正则引擎在编译特制的正则表达式时未进行充分的边界检查，可导致内存破坏。攻击者可通过向公开项目提交包含恶意正则表达式的 CI 配置文件，触发服务端进程（Puma/Sidekiq）中的内存破坏，从而实现任意代码执行。该漏洞利用路径可通过无需认证的 CI lint 接口到达，目前 PoC 已公开。
payload.official_solution:
请及时升级至 GitLab CE/EE 安全修复版本。
修复版本：19.2.8、19.3.5、19.4.2
下载链接：https://about.gitlab.com/update/
